page.overview:
Who is Noel's Final Fantasy XIII-2 battle quotes?

Noel is a playable character in Final Fantasy XIII-2 who utters various lines during battle depending on actions taken.

Stay on your toes! Let's end this! This'll be your grave! —Final battles

Stay on the ball! Have this! Dig in, now. Don't hurt yourself! —Phoenix Down

Take this! Hope this works. Go on, take it! All yours! —Librascope and Unicorn Horn
